Masjid Valley · A new beginning

Assalamu alaikum, neighbour 🌙

You've come to help restore the old masjid at the heart of the valley — its courtyard, its garden, and the gathering place by the cistern. Your grandmother's yard is yours now, and in time it can grow into a home. First, tell us who you are.

Boys wear a qamis; girls wear an abaya with hijab.

💾 Your progress saves automatically to this browser as you play — your farmer, the day, coins, crops, trust, bundle progress and your cat's affection all carry over to your next visit. Continue picks up right where you left off; starting a new valley replaces the saved one.

The valley, at Fajr

Welcome

Your first morning: meet Imam Yusuf by the masjid steps, speak to Umm Maryam near the garden, and plant something in your yard. The prayer banner will ring a soft ding at each prayer time — a picture and a sound, never the adhan itself.

📖 Journal

🗺 Masjid Valley

🕌 The Masjid — Ottoman stone, grey-blue domes, two pencil minarets. Imam Yusuf keeps the steps.
🎧 Listening Corner — a quiet room off the courtyard for recitation, and recitation only.
🌿 Your Yard — six soil plots, your house, and room to grow. Bilal the builder works from here.
💧 The Old Cistern — the gathering place. Restore it through its bundle.
🐐 Animal Pen — chickens, goats, sheep, and the beehives. Feed them, and they provide.
🌱 Glasshouse — locked until its bundle is done; then crops grow all year.
🎣 The Pond — fish with timing and patience. Skill, never luck.
⛏ The Cistern Works — the digging ground beside the old cistern: stone, clay and lime on a steady rotation for building.
🧺 Abu Khalid's Stall — seeds, tools and supplies; he buys your harvest too.
🌊 The River — fish with Salim on the east bank. Trout, carp and catfish by season and weather.
🌲 The Woods — forage sage, dates, thyme and rosehips from fixed spots; fallen branches give wood.
🦌 Hunting Grounds — deer and rabbits in the north-east woods. The shaykh teaches zabiha first.
🏠 Shaykh Abdullah's House — counsel: advice, religious judgments, dhikr and duaa. A visit costs one prayer block.
🍲 Community Kitchen — Hassan's cooking minigame, iftar prep, recipes earned from people.
📌 Noticeboard — by the masjid steps: neighbours' requests, the weather forecast, your yearly focus.
💧 Wudu Area & Library — restore them to unlock recipes and skill books.
🕌 Minaret Lookout — restore the minaret to see the whole valley and where everyone is.
📬 Mailbox — a letter most mornings. Check it by your gate.

The shape of a day

Days run Fajr to Isha, and the times shift with the season — Fajr and Maghrib move, so the Ramadan fast is longer in some years than others. Work costs energy; sleep restores it. Crops grow overnight when watered. Rain waters everything for free. If you don't greet a neighbour for about a week, their trust cools a little — a kind word warms it back.
